threads.note: Resolved in-thread and marked complete by the team. Adjet root-caused it - the parent was created ~70s after the child, so the child's price-code logic ran as a standalone job - and shipped a retrigger fix. My earlier claim that the PARENT's codes were wrong was incorrect and is retracted on COP-2081 (622126/622127); Ricardo confirmed {Derived CT Price Type} correctly maps a blank {CT Price Type} to GP, and the pricebook bands reconcile exactly (USSFC2 1,001-2,000 ft2 @199 = Job Rate, USGPC1 0-2,000 ft2 @120 = CT Rate). Still owed by me: the retrigger is UNVERIFIED - child 96932 was corrected by Caitlin by hand, so it proves nothing. Watch for a fresh Spec Ops job created parent-after-children and report the result on COP-2081.
